SD: The transcript import feature is excellent and saves a lot of manual entry time. The dashboard is clean, and the final career readiness score gives a very clear snapshot of where I stand. I would love to see an interactive, visual roadmap that shows exactly how my score will improve as I complete the recommended next steps. Adding engineering-specific industry benchmarks would also be highly valuable for final-year students.

The platform is incredibly intuitive and seamless to use. The transcript import capability is a massive time-saver, eliminating any tedious manual entry. The dashboard layout visualises data beautifully, making the career readiness score and the recommended next steps immediately actionable. It is an excellent tool for final-year students looking to streamline their career preparation.

The automation on this platform is fantastic. Importing transcripts is seamless, and the career readiness score is easy to understand. The next-step recommendations provide clear direction on what to focus on next.

The dashboard is exceptionally clean, well-structured, and highly scannable. Navigation between the core functions feels integrated and natural, and the next-step recommendations offer practical, concrete guidance.

I like most is how clutter-free the platform is. The dashboard presents critical metrics without overwhelming the user, and the time saved by the automated transcript import makes the onboarding process incredibly smooth
